# TRICERATOPS Historical Compatibility Module

Upstream: https://github.com/stevengiacalone/triceratops

Copyright (c) 2020 stevengiacalone. Distributed under the accompanying MIT
[LICENSE](LICENSE), retrieved from upstream during packaging.

`marginal_likelihoods_py312_compat_patched.py` is the historical modified module
saved with the TOI-1258 package, not an unmodified upstream release. Original
and export hashes appear in [the source inventory](../../SOURCE_INVENTORY.json).

This is not a standalone replacement for TRICERATOPS. Relative imports,
calibration tables and dependency versions must be reconciled before running it.
Preserving it does not mean its changes are independently validated. The upstream
MIT license does not determine licensing of the rest of this repository.
